facts.fact: Tanika发现自己的消息没能引起朱迪思的注意
facts.anchor: Tanika saw that her news didn’t seem to register with Judith.

facts.fact: Tanika说Gary Wise昨晚十一点刚过被枪杀
facts.anchor: Mr Wise was shot just after eleven o’clock last night?

facts.fact: 案发时屋内唯一另一个人是死者的妻子Bethany
facts.anchor: the only other person in the house at the time of his death was his wife, Bethany.

facts.fact: 凶手很可能同时拿走了Gary Wise的手机，至今未能找到
facts.anchor: Whoever killed him very possibly took his mobile phone as well. We’ve not been able to find it.

facts.fact: 今早案发现场Gary Wise家的固定电话响了
来电者是Daily Mirror跑犯罪线的记者
facts.anchor: The call came in from a journalist at the Daily Mirror. She explained that she covered her paper’s crime beat.

facts.fact: 前一天Gary Wise突然主动给这位记者打电话，说有事要告诉她
facts.anchor: Yesterday, Mr Wise rang her out of the blue. Said there was something he needed to tell her.

facts.fact: 朱迪思认为谋杀案不存在巧合
facts.anchor: when it came to murder, Judith didn’t believe in coincidences.

facts.fact: Becks问此案是否与Oliver Beresford案有关
facts.anchor: ‘Is it connected to Oliver Beresford?’ Becks asked.

facts.fact: 朱迪思说Beresford案的凶手昨晚已全面认罪
facts.anchor: Mr Beresford’s killer made a full confession last night.

facts.fact: 朱迪思上楼后拿起壁炉架上的旧拆信刀，在手里翻转端详
facts.anchor: picked up an old letter opener. Turning it over in her hands, she looked back at her four-poster bed

facts.fact: 朱迪思认为四十九年后不可能还有菲利波斯遇害的实证
facts.anchor: after forty-nine years, it was impossible that there could be any actual proof

facts.fact: Tanika留言要求三人去Hurley村Gary Wise家
facts.anchor: We’re to go to Gary Wise’s house in Hurley village.

facts.fact: Becks认为Tanika说尽快很反常，甚至可疑
facts.anchor: it’s borderline suspicious if you ask me. I wonder what’s changed?

facts.fact: Suzie抱怨朱迪思在有尸体要查时问填字游戏
facts.anchor: We’ve got a dead body to investigate and you’re asking about crosswords?
